Completed and extended the fix so it applies to all likely design-app entrypoints.

### Changes made
- Updated `semio/sketchpad/vite.config.ts` to resolve UI from local source:
  - `@semio/ui -> ../ui`
  - exact aliases for `@elements/ui` and `@elements/ui/elements` to `elements/ui/index.tsx`
- Updated `semio/sites/play/vite.config.ts` with the same alias strategy.
- Updated `semio/desktop/vite.renderer.config.ts` with the same alias strategy.

### Why this matters
Your sketchpad design app was likely loading a stale/packaged UI module instead of the current workspace UI implementation (which contains the navbar/toolbar rendering behavior). These aliases force all runtimes to use the in-repo source consistently.

### Verification performed
- `@semio/sketchpad` build: progressed to chunk rendering, then killed by environment (`137`), but alias resolution errors were fixed.
- `@semio/play` build: first showed alias path error (`...index.tsx/elements`), then after exact-regex alias fix progressed to chunk rendering and was killed (`137`).
- No lint errors were reported on changed config files earlier; later lints timed out (tool timeout).

If you want, I can next start `sketchpad` dev server and walk through a quick runtime checklist (navbar present, toolbar present, panel toggles visible) with you.
